Strategy: Pair items only when residuals spread out. When residuals span more than one item, aim for a leftover of one item; when bunched, tightness alone decides. Score by distance from a leftover of one item when wide, by Best Fit otherwise, exact fits tied at the top, so ranking switches from Best Fit only when wide. It may help by pairing when choice is rich, but may fail by ignoring pairing when bunched.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(abs(r - item - item)) + (item if r - item == 0 else 0) if max(bins) - min(bins) > item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Spread-conditional pairing: pairing target when max-min > item, else Best Fit.
